I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That comes from Dana's own posts in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. She first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 two minutes later. I couldn't see the signed amendment in the shared files, so I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to check it before the QBR (quarterly business review).

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
